title: A map onto a finite type module that is surjective on one stalk is surjective near that point
statement: Let $(X,\mathcal O_X)$ be a ringed space, $\varphi:\mathcal G\to\mathcal F$ a morphism of sheaves of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] and $x\in X$. Assume $\mathcal F$ is of finite type [def-weil-pbc-module-finite-type-presentation] (1) and that the induced map on stalks $\varphi_x:\mathcal G_x\to\mathcal F_x$ [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk] is surjective. Then there is an open neighbourhood $U$ of $x$ such that $\varphi|_U:\mathcal G|_U\to\mathcal F|_U$ is surjective as a map of sheaves: for every open $W\subseteq U$ and every $t\in\mathcal F(W)$ there are an open covering $W=\bigcup_iW_i$ and sections $g_i\in\mathcal G(W_i)$ with $\varphi_{W_i}(g_i)=t|_{W_i}$ for all $i$.

source.place: Modules, Lemma 01B8 (label lemma-finite-type-surjective-on-stalk, line 876) with its proof (choose generators s_1,...,s_n of F over U; lift each germ (s_i)_x along phi_x and shrink U so that s_i = phi(t_i)). Tag verified in stacks-project/tags/tags: 01B8,modules-lemma-finite-type-surjective-on-stalk

proof.text: Choose finite generators near x with the local coefficient property from [lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-local-coefficients].

Lift each generator germ by stalk surjectivity, represent its preimage on a smaller neighbourhood and use equality of germs to obtain a section lift. Intersect finitely many neighbourhoods with U0 and restrict all lifts there.

For each y in W contained in the common neighbourhood choose its local coefficient expansion. Use the same coefficients on the lifted generators. Naturality, linearity and restriction composition give a lift. Index the covering by points of W; it covers W because the neighbourhood chosen for each point contains that point. Finite intersection and empty sum handle n=0.

proof_origin.note: Lean implementation of Stacks 01B8 via finite local coefficient expansions, germ representation and finite intersection. Unit route preserved.

split_report.summary: Three steps following Stacks Modules 01B8: take the finite generating epimorphism near x; lift its finitely many generator germs and shrink once; for an arbitrary section, use the existing local-lifting characterization of an epimorphism of module sheaves to obtain local coefficients, then substitute the lifted generators. The empty-generator case is included. No new nodes.
